Shot on 35mm Kodak Portra 400 with moderate organic grain. Cinematic teal-crimson color grade, deep blacks. Anamorphic 2.39:1 with subtle horizontal flare. Shallow DoF. Single warm interrogation overhead + cold fluorescent fill. Volumetric neon haze from off-screen Chinese urban signage. Muted Japanese-urban-OL realism fused with western noir cinema grammar. Photorealistic.

Candid documentary still, not staged portrait. Subjects DOING something with hands/bodies/objects. Rarely facing camera unless confrontation is the scene. Present-continuous verbs. Specific physical tells only: half-raised brow, pressed lips, dilated pupils, corner-of-eye glance, jaw tension, lower lip pressing inward, nostril flare, chin drop, Adam's apple swallowing once, knuckles whitening, slow blink hold. Never use interpretive emotion words like composed, mysterious, sensual, seductive, predatory, amused, alluring, elegant. Body language: weight shift, hands mid-gesture, gaze directed at an object or middle distance. Strict anatomy: all mouths stay closed; lips sealed; no teeth; no mouth interior. ECU anatomy hygiene: body fragment in relaxed natural resting position, standard proportions. Shot Design: one shot does one thing.

Su Wan: Chinese woman, 28 years old, shoulder-length straight black hair parted on the side, thin sharp eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with dark irises, pale fair skin with cool undertone, slender 170cm frame, long legs. Minimal makeup, red lipstick. Half-body portrait at nondescript Chinese urban interior at night.

Motifs (anchor scope): no tier-2 motifs; nondescript interior setting; half-body crop does not reach thigh area, so no Layered Garment Visibility Rule activated. Light: Single warm interrogation overhead + cold fluorescent fill creating split-tone on face.

Action moment (80-150 words): Su Wan seated, breathing steadily, slight shoulder movement forward as if leaning into an interrogation table just outside frame. Gaze directed downward past camera, not at lens—her eyes scan something in the middle distance, perhaps her own hands resting on the table below the crop line. Half-lidded eyes, neutral expression, corners of mouth sealed. Warm overhead light catching the side of her face, casting her opposite eye into cool shadow. Neon haze from off-screen Chinese signage backlighting her hair silhouette. Captured as if shot by Gregory Crewdson for establishing—the suspended moment before a confession.

Aspect ratio 3:4, vertical portrait. Resolution: 2k. Model: grok-imagine-image-pro. Use anchor: false (this IS the anchor).
